scope: Only the four requested final-answer-token results. The first/last/mean position extension is intentionally excluded.

common_evaluation.direction_score: Projection of the teacher-forced final answer-span hidden state on the pre-existing canonical TriviaQA/ARC-Easy MD direction.
common_evaluation.answer_extraction: Generated text is parsed to its first line after stripping common chatty prefixes; empty output is excluded.
common_evaluation.correctness_normalization: SQuAD-style: lowercase, replace punctuation with spaces, remove articles a/an/the, collapse whitespace.
common_evaluation.alias_matching: Normalized exact match against any gold alias; independent-span matching is disabled in these final runs.
common_evaluation.target_token_definition: Last token overlapping the rendered answer character span, found with tokenizer offsets; special tokens normally have no answer-span offsets. Legacy fallback uses the last matched answer token or EOS-previous token.
common_evaluation.question_overlap_with_probe_training: None for reported held-out questions: directions are trained on the source dataset train split and D.3 evaluates only its test split.

triviaqa.template_assignment: Preserved from each source TriviaQA pair (template_id 0--2); it is not reassigned by the own-generation run.
triviaqa.generation_prompt: Five fixed closed-book QA demonstrations plus Q: <question> A:. Qwen/Llama use a system message; Mistral uses a single user message containing the demonstrations and question.
triviaqa.readout_context: assistant message containing the generated answer (post-answer self-readout)

arc_easy.template_assignment: Preserved source-pair template_id 0--2 in the deterministic 500-train/500-test manifest.
arc_easy.generation_prompt: Five fixed closed-book QA demonstrations plus Q: <question> A: in the Qwen system+user chat prompt.
arc_easy.readout_context: external_user: system + user message Q: <question> A: <generated answer>; this is post-answer teacher-forced reconstruction, not an assistant-message readout.
arc_easy.random_direction_control: Not run for the canonical ARC-Easy own-generation last-token result.
